properties.site-address: Anchor Garage, Shaftoe Street, Haydon Bridge
properties.notes: Proposal involves the redevelopment of an existing garage site and associated land within the village. Latest application for scheme of 9 units was permitted in 2017 (17/01547/FUL). This is yet to commence but it is forecast to be delivered by 2020/21. This revised scheme supersedes a previous approval for 6 dwellings (13/03434/FUL). Density reflects proposals for a flatted scheme.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
